_comment: Single source of truth for GaijinHome's automated article generation. Add new cities to the tier lists and new angles to problem_types — the generator picks them up automatically. Affiliate output is driven entirely by tier_affiliate_rules + each problem type's contexts, so revenue placement stays consistent as the map grows.

_tiers_note.tier_a: Full housing affiliates (Oakhouse, + CrossOneRoom for Tokyo). Revenue priority.
_tiers_note.tier_b: No housing affiliates. eSIM/WiFi only. Written as authority/general guides.
_tiers_note.tokyo_wards: Sub-areas of Tokyo. Same affiliate treatment as Tokyo (housing + CrossOneRoom). Only deployed after Tier A is exhausted.

_affiliate_logic_note: housing_affiliates apply when a problem type has a housing/sharehouse/budget context. tokyo_only_affiliates additionally apply when the area is Tokyo itself or one of its wards. connectivity_affiliates (eSIM/WiFi) apply to every article (arrival/relocation context).
